comment: Each race's own voice (tools/seed_npc_lines.py; entity/dialog.go's DialogVoice): a block's lines are said only by a
speaker of its speaker_race (by its body); "away" ones only by a guest of that race, in a town not its people's
(a fifth of the town's speakers or fewer), or on a road; the others by any of it, at home too. Trolls and ogres say
no common line (no town, no race), so theirs cover the roles and the moods. %p the listener's name, %r its race,
%c its class, %t the town the speaker stands in (a line with it is not said on a road), %n the speaker. Ours: the
user, 2026-11-01, "Bouncer Frada has Dark Elf dialogue, he is a guest only there, should still talk like Ogre",
"look throughout whole database for the races to have their own dialogue"; written in EQOA's voice from
claude-notes/eqoa-lore.md and the towns' own lines.

say: Me strong. You see? Me strong.
Rallos Zek make ogre for fighting. Ogre good at it.
You little. Me big. Dat how it is.
Me no think too much. Thinking make head hurt.
You want fight? No? Okay. Me eat instead.
Ogre no forget. Ogre just... not remember sometimes.
Me watch dis door. Nobody get past me.
You make trouble, me smash. Simple.
Boss say keep bad ones out. You bad one? You no look bad. Okay. Go.
Me stand here all day. Good job. Get paid in food.
You buy? Me no count good. You pay what fair. Me know if not fair.
Good stuff here. Me no break it. Mostly.
Shiny for stuff. Stuff for shiny. Dat how trade work.
Rallos Zek want blood and strong arms. You got strong arms?
Pray loud. Gods hear better when loud.
Me carry heavy thing. Me carry many heavy thing.
Work hard, eat good. Dat ogre life.
Oggok far away. Me miss mud of Feerrott.
%t people small and talk fancy. Me no understand half.
Dey pay me good here in %t. Food not so good.
Me come to %t for coin. Me stay for coin. Coin good.
Me no like you face. Go away before me decide.
Me watching you, %r. You do bad, me smash.
You stay, me smash. You go, maybe me no smash.
Me remember you. You bad. Go now.
Troll hungry. Troll always hungry.
You smell like food, %r. Good food.
Cazic-Thule watch troll. Troll no scared.
Frogloks bad. Frogloks crunchy, but bad.
Troll heal fast. Cut troll, troll still come.
Swamp good. Swamp wet. Troll like wet.
Troll watch. You no make trouble.
Me guard. Me bite if need.
Nobody sneak past troll. Troll nose know.
You walk. Me watch. Dat deal.
Troll sell good stuff. You pay shiny.
No eat da goods. Dat rule. Troll make rule hard to keep.
You want? Me got. You pay, you take.
Fear make strong. Cazic-Thule teach dat.
Bring offering. Meat good offering.
Dig, carry, dig. Troll no tired.
Work done. Now eat. Den more work.
Grobb far. %t smell funny, but food okay.
Troll miss swamp. %t too dry.
%t folk look at troll funny. Troll look back. Dey stop.
Troll come to %t for work. Troll get paid in meat. Good deal.
Troll no trust you. You keep hands where troll see.
You smell like trouble, %r. Troll no like trouble. Troll eat trouble.
You go now, or troll have dinner.
Troll remember face. Your face bad.
Hate is honest, %r. Kindness is only a mask for weakness.
Innoruuk's children owe nothing to anyone. Remember that.
Every house in Neriak keeps its knives sharp. So do I.
Do not mistake my presence in %t for friendship.
I am here on House business. Yours, I suspect, is elsewhere.
%t is crude, but it is useful. That is all I ask of a place.
The surface is too bright. I count the days until Neriak's dark.
They tolerate me in %t because they fear what I might do otherwise. Wise of them.
Keep your distance, %r. I have not decided what you are worth.
Tunare's grace on you, %r.
Listen to the trees long enough and they will tell you everything.
A song carries further than a sword, and does less harm on the way.
I miss the songs of Fayspires. %t has only noise.
There are too few trees in %t. Tunare finds me even so.
The Feir'dal travel more than they let on. I am proof of it.
%t is kind enough, in its way. It simply forgets to be quiet.
Marr watch over you, %r.
Work hard, trade fair, and keep your blade where you can reach it.
There is no road in Norrath a human has not walked. Most of them twice.
A long way from Freeport, this. Or Qeynos, depending who asks.
%t has its ways. I keep my head down and my purse closer.
I came to %t for the trade and stayed for the coin.
Humans go everywhere, %r. Someone has to.
Brell keep you, %r. Stone is the only honest thing in Norrath.
A good axe, a good ale and a deep mine. What else is there?
Never trust a beard you can see through.
The ale in %t is thin as a goblin's excuse.
Moradhim is under the mountain, where a dwarf belongs. I'm here for the work.
Too much sky in %t. A dwarf feels it pressing on his head.
They build with wood here. Wood! I give it ten winters.
Mind the gears, %r! Everything worth doing is half finished.
Bristlebane favors the curious. And the small. And the quick.
If it can be wound up, I can make it walk. Eventually.
%t has no proper workshops! I've had to make my own.
Klick'Anon ticks and hums all night. %t is so terribly quiet.
The folk of %t think my inventions explode. Only the early ones do.
I came to %t for the parts. Wonderful scrap here, if you know where to look.
Have you eaten, %r? Never trust a place that doesn't feed you.
A full belly and a short walk home: that's a good day.
Bristlebane laughs at the tall folk. I try not to, out loud.
Rivervale's pies, now that's a reason to travel. %t's, not so much.
Everything in %t is built for the tall. I've had to climb onto three stools today.
I miss the river. %t has no proper fishing at all.
The Tribunal sees all, %r. Even what you hide.
A Northman settles a quarrel with fists, then shares an ale. Simpler that way.
Cold makes you strong. Ale makes you warm. Both make you a barbarian.
Too warm in %t. A Northman sweats like a bear in spring.
In Halas they would have sung songs about this place. Short ones.
%t folk talk and talk. In Halas we would have finished the fight by now.
I miss the snow. Snow is honest.
Knowledge is the only coin that keeps its worth, %r.
Quellious teaches patience. I am still learning it.
Ignorance is a choice. A remarkably popular one.
One learns a great deal in %t, chiefly about the limits of others.
Highbourne's libraries would humble this whole town. Still, %t has its curiosities.
I am here to study. The locals are, regrettably, part of the study.
